questions.q: How is this lab's Onboarding Wizard flow typically launched?
options: From a Quick Action directly on the closed Opportunity record
Automatically, every midnight, as a Scheduled Flow
Only by a System Administrator through Setup
Automatically whenever any Lead is created
questions.explain: The wizard is a screen flow a rep launches from a Quick Action on the Opportunity the moment a deal closes.

questions.q: What does the 'Needs Implementation Project?' Decision control?
options: Whether the Opportunity can be closed at all
Whether the flow runs before save or after save
Whether the Contact record is created
Whether the flow branches into an extra screen (Schedule Kickoff Call) or skips straight to creating records
questions.explain: The Decision gates an entire conditional screen — only deals needing implementation reach the kickoff-scheduling screen; others skip straight to record creation.

questions.q: What two records does the flow create in Step 4?
options: A new Opportunity and a new Account
The primary Contact and an onboarding Task
A Case and a Campaign
Two duplicate Contact records
questions.explain: Create Records runs twice: once for the primary Contact, once for an onboarding Task assigned to the account owner.

questions.q: Why can this lab's fault path show $Flow.FaultMessage directly on a screen, unlike the Lead Assignment or Case Escalation labs?
options: Because Create Records elements never fail
Because the flow runs with elevated permissions
Because $Flow.FaultMessage only works in screen flows
Because this is a screen flow, and screen flows (unlike before-save or after-save flows) can use Display Text elements
questions.explain: Before-save and after-save flows can't use screen elements, so earlier labs wrote FaultMessage to a field instead — a screen flow can show it directly, as Lesson 20 originally demonstrated.

questions.q: According to the outro, what course comes next in the Salesforce Administrator path after Flow Automation?
options: Apex Programming
Salesforce Reports and Dashboards
Lightning Web Components
Business Process Automation
questions.explain: Business Process Automation is the next course in the Salesforce Administrator path, continuing directly after Flow Automation.
